scope: read-only offline independent QA of new route-only admission and scoped8M cap

findings.title: Real queue top-level prior access refusals do not close original-URI admission
findings.source: explicit_access_boundary checks only the bound fetch object and its nested history/robots; capture top-level attemptHistory is used to collect observed original URLs but not to retain refusals on the related HTTPS URI.
findings.consequence: A known prior related-root/robots refusal in the actual queue storage shape can be bypassed by admitting the original HTTP route despite the intended refusal-retention rule.
findings.recommendation: Include relevant captures top-level histories in explicit-access-boundary admission checks; add the real queue-shape test. Keep this scoped to the same original/related root rather than unrelated URLs.

findings.title: Orphan wire event after transport exception permits another one-shot original-URI attempt
findings.source: _transport persists its wire event before calling the real transport and in finally; execute catches only RetryAfterDeferred and writes the completed item after fetch returns. Admission consumes captures/items but does not consume the wireEvents-only footprint.

reproduction.fixture: OriginalURIObservationTests + size_proof + same coordination/load_fetcher mocks as existing per-fetch cap test
reproduction.fakeTransport: FakePublicFetcher._wire delegates to self._transport; _transport raises RuntimeError; fetch calls self._wire(originalURL)

findings.consequence: A timeout/transport exception or hard interrupt can leave an attempted route re-admissible, repeating the one-shot 8M request.
findings.recommendation: Conservatively close one-shot admission from its durable attempt/wire footprint and save an accurate exception receipt when possible. Do not invent final URL or completed page-request proof when response/transport completion is unknown; hard-interrupt orphan wires must also close admission.
